summary: Iteration 10 billing/trial overhaul + accessibility re-wire verified via web preview as trades.demo. 4-tab layout (HOME/MODULES/CAPTURE/SETTINGS, no Profile tab) ships; profile route still reachable from Settings → Profile. Trial banner renders globally (hidden on /login, /billing) — shows '12 days left in your Trades & Construction free trial · Tap to upgrade' and routes to /billing. Settings tab fully populated (identity row, plan-summary card 3/5 unlocked / 3 in trial / 0 paid, account section, plan & notifications section, Talk to support, Sign out). Billing dashboard renders all 5 industry cards with correct status badges (Trades TRIAL 12D, Transport TRIAL 14D, Retail TRIAL 14D, Healthcare NOT SUBSCRIBED, Hospitality EXPIRED). Plans sheet opens and the monthly/annual cycle toggle works. Capture and Modules tabs gate correctly — Transport in-trial section renders inline with '14D LEFT' pill, locked-tile grid surfaces remaining industries. Accessibility widget now actually applies prefs on web — clicking Larger boosts html font-size from 16px → 20.8px and a <style id='safebase-a11y-style'> tag is injected; dyslexia/high-contrast/emphasize-links rules also append to the tag. Two non-blocking findings: backend returns 0 plans for transport (frontend correctly shows 'No plans available'), and the Hospitality card returns EXPIRED rather than the CANCELING state the request expected — for EXPIRED both 'Start free trial' and 'View plans & upgrade' buttons render simultaneously which is mildly confusing.

minor.issue: Returns plans: [] for Transport while every other industry returns 6–8 plans. PlansSheet correctly shows 'No plans available' but transport trial holders cannot upgrade. Backend seed needs transport tiers.

ui_bugs.issue: When status.kind === 'expired' the card renders BOTH a 'Start free trial' PrimaryButton AND a 'View plans & upgrade' PrimaryButton. Two equally-weighted primary CTAs are ambiguous — pick one (recommend Upgrade for expired, Start free trial for none).

tabBarTestID for HOME/MODULES/CAPTURE/SETTINGS does NOT propagate to the rendered web tab buttons (no [data-testid="tab-settings"] etc. nodes in DOM). Tab labels can still be tapped by text. Consider wrapping each tab with tabBarButton that forwards testID, otherwise automation has to rely on visible text.

integration_issues.issue: User on Transport trial taps 'View plans & upgrade' → modal opens → 'No plans available' shown. Cannot exercise POST /billing/checkout-industry for Transport. Other industries have plans listed.

issues: Two primary CTAs stacked for EXPIRED state is visually noisy (Hospitality card)
StatusBadge for trial uses authority blue same tone as the upgrade button — secondary contrast OK on dark surface.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses 'pointerEvents: "box-none"' inline style with @ts-ignore. Console emits 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning (already on style, fine) but this warning is global and originates from a different RNW upstream package — non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/TrialBanner.tsx:63

action_items: Backend: seed Transport plans (currently 0 → frontend shows 'No plans available'). All other industries are fine.
Billing card: collapse the two-primary-CTA pattern for EXPIRED state — show 'Start free trial' only when kind === 'none', 'View plans & upgrade' only when kind in (trial, expired, canceling).

Reconcile expected vs actual statuses for trades.demo: spec said Hospitality=CANCELING + Retail=NOT SUBSCRIBED, backend now returns Hospitality=EXPIRED + Retail=TRIAL. Either re-seed the demo account or update the spec/copy.
Optional: ensure tab-* testIDs reach the DOM on web (custom tabBarButton). Not blocking but improves automation.
critical_code_review_comments: BillingScreen actions branching renders Start-Trial AND Upgrade for 'expired' kind concurrently — refactor to a single branch.

AccessibilityContext.applyToRNDefaults mutates Text/TextInput.defaultProps imperatively — works but the inherited style overrides any per-component undefined family. Safe today; revisit if a screen explicitly needs system font while dyslexia mode is on.

BillingContext.statusFor never returns kind 'canceling' from a sub whose backend status string is literally 'canceling' unless statusKind handles that — verify the api/billing.ts statusKind mapping covers 'canceling' (UI relies on it for the canceling pill).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via inputs[0]/inputs[1] + page.get_by_text('SIGN IN').first.click(force=True). Tabs lack data-testid on web — navigate directly via /settings, /capture, /modules, /billing, /profile. trades.demo currently has trades + transport + retail in TRIAL, healthcare NONE, hospitality EXPIRED. Accessibility verification: read getComputedStyle(documentElement).fontSize after toggling a11y-font-1_3 → expect 20.8px; check document.getElementById('safebase-a11y-style').innerHTML for injected rules.
rca_of_issue: Two minor UX/data gaps surfaced. (1) Backend /billing/plans?industry=transport returns plans:[] — likely the seed_billing_plans script omitted Transport. Reproduce: curl https://safe-systems.preview.emergentagent.com/api/billing/plans?industry=transport → {plans:[]}. Mitigation: seed transport tiers identically to trades. (2) BillingScreen renders two primary buttons for 'expired' kind because the two conditional blocks (line 161 'none||expired' and line 172 'trial||expired||canceling') both include 'expired'. Mitigation: remove 'expired' from the second branch OR remove from the first.
